bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing top word co-occurrences and topic distributions associated with age-related social identity terms (e.g., "elderly", "old age") to identify stereotyped or negative associations in text datasets like C4.

Calculating co-occurrences between queer identity terms in text and sexual imagery or explicit topics in associated images (using visual content and topic classifiers) in multimodal datasets like LAION-400M.
Counting gender pronoun distributions in text to evaluate representation, and measuring stereotypical associations between perceived gender and objects/activities in image datasets.

Counting the occurrence of hateful terms and ethnic slurs in text, and calculating the proportion of images depicting social identity groups using perceived features like skin tone to detect under-representation.
Analyzing metadata such as source URL geographic spread and top country-level domains to evaluate cultural representation skews in training data.
Calculating the proportion of documents representing specific languages and dialects using language classifiers to identify under-represented or marginalized linguistic groups.
